notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve signup. Customer is an ecommerce startup (B2C) building an in-product chat assistant + lightweight recommendation reranking. Primary contact: CTO Maya Lin. Early feedback: 'responses are slow and spike unpredictably' — reported by 2 devs after testing in us-east-1. They tested with sample payloads (avg 420 tokens total prompt+history) and see p95 ~700ms for generation calls, goal is p95 < 250ms for quick UI interactions. Native cost sensitivity: wants to keep monthly hosted spend < $2k while still hitting latency targets.

What the customer told us / pain: short sessions in product where customers expect near-instant replies. They tried default region on signup (us-east-1) and saw occasional 1s+ tails during bursts. No dedicated capacity; strictly public cloud. They asked about region guidance, timeout settings, and prompt-length best practices. Not worried about on-prem; SOC2 and SSO required for future upgrade.

SE notes / triage so far: collected sample request logs and token counts (attached to INF-1123). Observed large system prompts in some flows (500+ tokens static system + 200 token user history) — easy win to trim system prompt + truncate history to recent turns. Reproduced latency spike locally by simulating 10 concurrent requests with 80 token outputs; p50 ~160ms, p95 ~720ms (same order as reported).

Recommended immediate guidance given to customer: 
- Region: try us-west-2 for West-coast latency and us-east-1 for East; run A/B checks. We provided a small region latency matrix (drive:/region_latency/lichenspark-matrix.csv). They agreed to test us-west-2 as quick experiment.
- Timeout: set client-side timeout to 30s for now; reduce HTTP retry backoff to avoid queuing spikes. Server SLOs support shorter timeouts but client retry storms worsen tail latency.
- Prompt length: reduce static system prompt to <= 200 tokens; aggressively truncate conversation history to last 2 turns for UI where speed is prioritized. Provide template: system concise + 1-2 recent exchanges.
- Streaming: enable streaming responses in UI to show partial results and improve perceived latency for users.
- Model variants / tokens: use smaller, faster model variant for UI quick answers and reserve higher-quality model for long-form generation or scheduled batch jobs.
- Batching/caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts (product descriptions), and set up 50ms micro-batching to increase throughput if they move to bursty periods.

POC proposal: 2-week lightweight perf tuning POC (no Dedicated). Week 1: region swap to us-west-2, implement prompt trimming + streaming, measure p50/p95 and tokens per call. Week 2: test micro-batching and caching on a small subset of traffic, iterate. Deliverable: perf report with recommended defaults, expected cost delta, and rollout checklist.

Quotes from call: "We want snappy replies — if it feels slow we lose customers in checkout flows." CTO Maya Lin.

Next steps (agreed):
- Jordan to schedule 1-hr workshop with Priya (SE) and Maya for 2026-03-15.
- Customer to push a 24-hour test to us-west-2 and share logs (assigned INF-1123).
- We to share lightweight region latency matrix and 'prompt trimming' one-pager (drive links above).

Other notes: budgetary pushback likely at procurement; small ARR expected first year. Potential upsell to Optimize or Dedicated as they prove value and need lower tail latency. Keep CSM loop-in if they sign.
